reuse.why: Keeps getScheduledAmount as the single expected-amount helper, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, and the API field calls the same helper.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; each caller that was changed passes the op through to the shared helper, though the `false, op` argument tuple repeats at every site.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts and the API field in api-models' scheduleModel, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Mostly focused; an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts and three release notes for one cumulative change add noise.

maintainability.why: The new optional `op` parameter means callers that omit it (SchedulesTable, mobile schedule list, useScheduleEdit) silently get the non-approximate rule, and the positional `inverse` boolean makes every call `(amount, false, op)`.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All changed sites go through getScheduledAmount; none re-implements it.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount's rangeRounding parameter is replaced by an optional `op` and gains an `op === 'isapprox'` branch; several desktop-client callers (SchedulesTable.tsx, SchedulesListItem.tsx, MobileSchedulesPage.tsx, useScheduleEdit.ts) still call it without op, so the approximate rule depends on each caller remembering to pass it.
